purpose: Classroom EMG shared physical scene, ported from the independent Windows G1 four-command validation demo
controller: NVIDIA Decoupled WBC Balance/Walk, original pretrained ONNX weights
adaptations: CPU-only ONNX Runtime, one inference thread, no PyTorch/CUDA/ROS/DDS dependency
Cue-driven and classification-driven Qt scene with a worker-owned MuJoCo physics/rendering loop
Same 86D observations, six-frame history, original scaling and PD gains
Original lower-body policy output including waist; zero upper-body PD targets
Bounded command acceleration and straight-motion heading feedback inspired by Teleopit
Explicit STOP, stale-command timeout, ready-after-standing signal, and fall detection
Scene closing ends the experiment and finalizes captured data; keyboard commands are reserved for the standalone prototype
No motion clips, policy retraining, EMG recording format or DDS protocol changes
